Definition: Jerocham, the name of seven or eight Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Jeroham is the name of seven or eight Israelites, and the father of Elkanah is one of them. In 1 Samuel 1:1, the son of Jeroham. The fuller story is told on the Jeroham, Son of Eliab profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that Jeroham belongs in the story because God put the name there, and I trust the placing.
